For data science and AI work under ₹80,000 put your money into memory and storage first, and a graphics card second.

RAM: 16 GB at minimum, 32 GB if you can find it. Big datasets and notebooks eat memory fast.
Storage: 512 GB SSD or more. Datasets and environments add up quickly.
Chip: A recent Ryzen 7 or Core Ultra 7 is plenty. Avoid older or entry-level chips.
Graphics card: An Nvidia RTX card helps only if you'll train small networks on the laptop. If not, a lighter laptop plus free cloud notebooks gives you more for the money.
The rest: A comfortable keyboard, a good 14 to 16 inch screen and decent battery matter more than they look when you code all day.
